source_files: CaptainCook4D GoPro 360p recordings 23_5 and 16_1 via public Box links in https://github.com/CaptainCook4D/downloader (metadata/download_links.json)
note: One example = one row of annotations.json: a segment of a source cooking video for which an LLM rewrote the recipe instruction so that what the person actually did becomes a mistake (counterfactual), plus the feedback the assistant should give and its timestamp. Times are seconds in the full source recording; the video itself shows correct behaviour relative to the original recipe. Annotations are under QTI's Research-Use DLA (no redistribution to third parties) — check before making this page public; clips are CaptainCook4D (Apache-2.0).
